ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent charges filed against the owner of a Minnesota agency and explore the broader issue of Medicaid fraud in the state.
questions: What are the underlying causes of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can the state improve oversight and accountability in the Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for reform in the Medicaid program. I recommend starting with a review of public records and interviewing experts in the field.
